## Import Libraries
```{r Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

## Import Data
```{r import data}
# qc cutoff data
df <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/02_QualityControl/03-OceanWaterQualityData-QCCutoff.csv")

# whole time series
dfWhole <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/WholeSeriesDescriptiveStats.csv")

# yearly
dfYear <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/YearlyDescriptiveStats.csv")

# monthly
dfMonth <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/MonthlyDescriptiveStats.csv")

# daily
dfDay <- read_csv("Data/CleanData/CleanData_YSI/03_DescriptiveStatistics/DailyDescriptiveStats.csv")
```

# Basic Plots
```{r basic plots}
# whole time series #not sure if want to plot this yet bc it's just one value instead of multiple values spanning  time intervals

# yearly
pHPlot_year <- dfYear %>%
  filter(variable == "pH") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(y = mean,
                  ymin = mean - std,
                  ymax = mean + std,
                  fill = "Standard Deviation"), 
              alpha = 0.2,
              show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(y = median,
                  ymin = Q1,
                  ymax = Q3,
                  fill = "Interquartile Range"), 
              alpha = 0.2,
              show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(y = mean,
                  ymin = min,
                  ymax = max,
                  fill = "Range"), 
              alpha = 0.1,
              show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean, color = "Mean"), show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median, color = "Median"), show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = length(unique(dfYear$year)))+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(0.25, 0.45, 0.25, 0.25, "inch"))+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))+
  labs(title = "B2O pH Yearly Statistics from 2011-2023")+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("pH")

# Save plot
# ggsave(filename = "TempFPlot-PostQC.pdf", plot = TempFPlot_PostQC, 
#        path = "Figures/Figures_YSI/02-PostQCPlots")
pHPlot_year

# monthly
pHPlot_month <- dfMonth %>%
  mutate(date = paste(year, month, 01, sep = "-"),
         date = as.Date(strptime(date, format = "%Y-%b-%d"))) %>%
  filter(variable == "pH",
         date >= "2015-01-01" & date < "2023-01-01") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(yday(date), "2021-01-01"),
             y = mean,
             color = factor(year(date)))) +
  geom_line() +
  # geom_line(aes(y = median, color = "Median"), show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b")+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(0.25, 0.45, 0.25, 0.25, "inch"))+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))+
  labs(title = "B2O pH Monthly Statistics from 2011-2023")+
  xlab("Date")+
  ylab("pH")
pHPlot_month

# daily

```

```{r test chunk}
x <- seq(0.01, .99, length.out = 100)
df <- data.frame(
  x = rep(x, 2),
  y = c(qlogis(x), 2 * qlogis(x)),
  group = rep(c("a","b"),
  each = 100)
)
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y, group=group))
p
# These work
p + geom_line(linetype = 2)
p + geom_line(aes(colour = group), linetype = 2)
p + geom_line(aes(colour = x))
```
